layer_name: Slide 1: “At the core of our mission is a commitment to creating pieces that will stir your soul and invite you inward.” - Founder, Donnie Soddu Slide 2: Dear reader, High Light began as a personal pursuit, a creative outlet, an escape. As a mother and person of color with a deep respect for nature, I felt a strong pull to create something hopeful and environmentally responsible. Slide 3: I decided to channel my experience in the fashion, wellness and beauty industries to create a company that combines timeless design with a sense of intentionality and care for our shared future. Slide 4: To me, High Light is about the practice. The shift in mindset toward the deeper appreciation and compassion that our future requires. Slide 5: The pieces we create are simply manifestations of that mindset, made to help support that shift. I hope they bring you pleasure and peace. — Donnie

Slide Three: Image Slide Four: Invite your demons to tea. Slide Five: Their wisdom may surprise you. Slide Six: Your Shadow Self longs to be accepted & seen. It asks you to get curious about the parts of yourself that you reject, so that you can live a more empowered and authentic life. Slide Seven: The Shadow offers wisdom and clarity. It celebrates your wholeness. Slide Eight: Honor & integrate your Shadow through ritual, journaling, meditation, practicing non-judgment, & working with a professional. Slide Nine: Your Shadow Self is full of rich wisdom, lessons, and deep self-love.

layer_name: Before you know what kindness really is you must lose things, feel the future dissolve in a moment like salt in a weakened broth. What you held in your hand, what you counted and carefully saved, all this must go so you know how desolate the landscape can be between the regions of kindness. How you ride and ride thinking the bus will never stop, the passengers eating maize and chicken will stare out the window forever. Before you learn the tender gravity of kindness, you must travel where the Indian in a white poncho lies dead by the side of the road. You must see how this could be you, how he too was someone who journeyed through the night with plans and the simple breath that kept him alive. Before you know kindness as the deepest thing inside, you must know sorrow as the other deepest thing. You must wake up with sorrow. You must speak to it till your voice catches the thread of all sorrows and you see the size of the cloth. Then it is only kindness that makes sense anymore, only kindness that ties your shoes and sends you out into the day to mail letters and purchase bread, only kindness that raises its head from the crowd of the world to say it is I you have been looking for, and then goes with you every where like a shadow or a friend.

layer_name: Caption find your sanctuaries we tend to think of a sanctuary as somewhere we have to escape to. somewhere quiet, beautiful, far enough away from everyday life that we can finally exhale. but finding sanctuary doesn’t require escape, expense, or excess. a sanctuary is a container. a space that gives you something you need in order to come back to yourself. and different sanctuaries can give us different things. a library can be a sanctuary because it gives you somewhere to feed your mind. you can find writers who make you feel less alone, ideas that open something up in you, or words that bring you new perspective. water can be a sanctuary when you need to clear your energy. your body can be a sanctuary because it is the one home you always carry with you. a place where you can belong to yourself completely. where you don’t have to perform, prove, or be anything other than who you are. your rituals can create sanctuary when they connect you to the sacred. you might have more than one sanctuary. I know I do. as you keep building your grounding practice this month, find your sanctuaries and practice returning to them. these are the spaces that bring you back - that help you feel more like yourself again. #wordsforyourjourney #gentlereminders
